name: National Museum of Liberia
subtitle: Established in 1958 and housed in the Old Supreme Court building since 1987, the museum lost around 5,000 artefacts during the wars and is rebuilding its collection.

parts.text: Established in 1958 and housed in the Old Supreme Court building since 1987, the museum lost around 5,000 artefacts during the wars and is rebuilding its collection. It was renovated in 1992 with international assistance.
